text.p: State-run Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy is unlikely to seek a listing in the U.S. or abroad in connection with a planned share issue, a senior Trade And Industry Ministry official said on Wednesday.

"(The share offering) will have a domestic and foreign element but I don't think there will be such a listing aspect," permanent under-secretary of state Matti Vuoria told Reuters when asked whether there were plans to list Kemira in the U.S. or on any other foreign market.
Apart from Helsinki, Kemira is listed on the SEAQ in London. Its shares have been issued in the United States under regulation 144A to be traded by institutional investors.
Kemira last week announced plans to issue up to eight million new shares worth 6.6 percent of its equity capital.
The government has announced plans to lower its stake to 55 percent from the current 72.3 percent.
